what: A rhythm box of ceremony percussion: djembe, cajon, udu, clapsticks, maracas and triangle on the black keys, a step sequencer on the white keys. The berimbau and the capoeira's bateria have their own page. A tanpura and a shruti box sound alone or under the rhythm.
author: Jess Del Rio
